description: I'm a founding product designer. I've spent 13 years helping startups design and ship products, and now I'm building Uncomn and KnowHim.

intro.headline: Launch your product in seven days.
intro.body: I'm a fractional founding designer. I help founders launch products using design thinking and Claude Code, and I carry intuitive experiences all the way through to deployment.

quote: I use AI to augment my ignorance, not outsource my intelligence.

past.headline: 13 years at Kaleo Design. 3.5 years leading design at FlutterFlow.
past.body: I ran Kaleo Design, my product studio, for 13 years. I also spent three and a half years as Head of Design at FlutterFlow, where we went from zero to 2.3M users and helped raise $30M+.
